column1: # The port's own C for functions the decompilation has as matching C (hostgen.json "overrides"):
# the matched definition is left out of hostgen's prepared copy and this C goes at the end of its
# file, translated like the game's C. For what the port has to do otherwise than the matching C says
# (a 64-bit value an int keeps, a result retail leaves in a register the C declares void, a stack
# slot retail reads before it is written); the decompilation stays as it matches. Each file says why.
